name: Administrator
cooked:
This site isn’t configured to send emails at the moment.

This includes notifications about posts and means to keep up-to-date on new topics, you’ll have to visit the site.

This seemed to be easier for a first setup, and I don’t want to bother with sending emails at the moment. However, I might enable outgoing email support at some point.

If you’re frequently missing notifications due to not getting emails, feel free to comment here.
raw:
This site isn't configured to send emails at the moment. 

This includes notifications about posts and means to keep up-to-date on new topics, you'll have to visit the site.

This seemed to be easier for a first setup, and I don't want to bother with sending emails at the moment. However, I might enable outgoing email support at some point.

If you're frequently missing notifications due to not getting emails, feel free to comment here.
